URL and time.Location parsers not working for value types

#### Description

When trying to parse environment variables into `url.URL` and `time.Location` fields, the parser fails to find the appropriate parser functions. The error indicates "no parser found for field" even though these types should be supported.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```go
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "net/url"
    "time"
    
    "github.com/caarlos0/env/v11"
)

type Config struct {
    ExampleURL  url.URL       `env:"EXAMPLE_URL"`
    Location    time.Location `env:"LOCATION"`
}

func main() {
    cfg := Config{}
    if err := env.Parse(&cfg); err != nil {
        fmt.Printf("Error: %v\n", err)
    }
}
```

Running this with environment variables set:
```bash
export EXAMPLE_URL="https://example.com"
export LOCATION="America/New_York"
go run main.go
```

Results in:
```
Error: env: no parser found for field "ExampleURL" of type "url.URL"; no parser found for field "Location" of type "time.Location"
```

The same issue occurs with slices and pointer types of these structs. Expected behavior would be for the URL and Location to be parsed successfully using the built-in parsers.
</pr_description>
